newsitem.title: UK: London Stock Exchange gets first Chinese listing.
newsitem.headline: London Stock Exchange gets first Chinese listing.

text.p: The Zhenhai Refining and Chemical Company Limited will become the first Chinese company to be listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE) on Friday.
The LSE said in a statement that the petrochemical company, whose offer was around 10 times oversubscribed, had raised $200 million gross through a convertible bond issue.

The listing was made possible by a memorandum of understanding signed in October by United Kingdom and Chinese regulatory authorities. The memorandum provides Chinese companies with direct access to London markets.
Vice Premier Li Lanqing visited the exchange in November.
Zhenhai produces and sells petroleum products such as diesel fuel, gasoline, urea and kerosene.
